scope: Observed native Loft closure boolean and ordered straight sketch rails, with existing section, solid/surface, merge and Free/Direction controls. No procedural loft geometry regeneration.

integration.callsite: Use this independent reader for the Loft tool branch. It does not import decode_loft and therefore introduces no fallback cycle.
integration.compatibility: Prior semantic controls and explicit section/centerline references are retained. Corrected End-control framing now identifies its post-weight count as the rail count; endpoint byte lengths and raw-field names reflect that correction.

layout.closure_flag: One native boolean after counted rail references, followed immediately by the solid/surface boolean. No-rail Free-end captures put these atbody37and38; optional parameters/centerline/rails shift the offsets, so production uses the structural cursor.
layout.rails: After End optional angle, condition code and optional weight: uint32 rail_count, then rail_count owned2CA selection references. Observed counts0,1,2; each resolves a single typed SketchLine ID/tag. Order matches API guide collection.
layout.post_flags: Four following zero bytes are preserved as an observed guard without assigning an alignment enum meaning.
layout.endpoint_integers: The first int32 in End/Start stored control blocks is(-1,-1) without rails,(-1,0) with one rail,(1,0) with two rails. Values are retained and these combinations guarded; field meanings remain unresolved.
layout.closed_controls: Closed captures retain stored Free blocks but API endpoint conditions are absent. Production exposes active start/end and per-section conditions as null when closed, with stored blocks separately available.

notes: The matched four-section open and closed solid captures differ only atbyte37 within the first128 feature-body bytes. Closed solid versus closed surface differs only atbyte38 in that region. These controlled contrasts establish the two booleans independently.

Rail source references are explicit typed proxy/descriptor/sketch-tag chains. Cached line geometry plus the existing sketch-to-component transform matches API root-component endpoints; no nearest-geometry matching is used.
Both one-rail solid and surface variants and a two-rail solid variant were captured successfully.
No BRep rail edge-condition enum is assigned to sketch rails, where the SDK says that property is inapplicable.
Older closure uncertainty is resolved for this observed feature layout; unsupported variants remain rejected.
limitations: Only zero/one/two straight sketch rails or the earlier single straight centerline are supported.
Closed lofts with rails/centerlines or non-Free stored endpoint controls remain unverified and are rejected.
Closed point, face, path or multiple-profile sections are unverified; current sections remain single sketch profiles.
Raw endpoint integer and edge-alignment semantics are unresolved outside captured combinations.
No exact loft surface reconstruction, persistent topology mapping, kernel regeneration or native writer.
